timeline.tweet: My big relapse at the start of this year was after a second house move in a year, times of stress definitely problematic for me #PNDhour
I'm also hyper-aware and hubs is too, I've just started yoga with relaxation and trying to incorporate daily mindfulness #pndhour
I did the same, I had a lot of activities planned, swimming, sing and sign, library sessions, gym, that kind of thing, I found it helped to have a focus each day #pndhour

I had Postpartum Psychosis after my son was born and this is the main reason I decided not to have another. I also struggled physically through pregnancy and have since been diagnosed with bipolar #pndhour
I’m here, Mum of 1, recovered from postpartum psychosis, returned to work, after a year off, on a part time basis #pndhour
For me returning to work was important, I felt I needed to get back that part of my identity and eventually I started to feel like me again, work is a part of who we are #PNDHour
Once I was out of the MBU I fought back against the anxiety and made myself go to classes, groups or just out, it was hard but so worth it #pndhour
I avoid alcohol completely, haven’t touched it in 4 years, also limit amount of caffeine during the day and none past 5pm #MumovementHour
Hi, I’m Katy, I suffered Postpartum Psychosis after the birth of my son 3 years ago and had another episode of mania/depression last year #blurtchats
I lost a colleague to ovarian cancer, she died 4 weeks after she was diagnosed leaving behind two small children, it can be so devastating, know the symptoms #OvarianAwarenessMonth

At the very beginning of motherhood, my psychosis led me to believe that I was ‘supermum’ I felt childbirth had changed me, once I knew I was ill I still felt different, I just didn’t have a solid idea of how or who I was now #PNDHour

I’m lucky to have returned to work part time and for me it’s such a good balance, I get time with my boy, time at work and time as a whole family, I felt my identity was more solid after return to work #pndhour

I try to keep bedtime/wake up time roughly consistent, music on, relax with a book or puzzle book, sometimes a hot bath, horlicks or cocoa, limit caffeine through day, none past 4:30pm, offload about my day at some point in the evening #pndhour
I didn’t know at first at all, I thought childbirth had changed me in a positive way, turned me into supermum, made me enjoy food I previously hated, meant I didn’t need any sleep #pndhour

My boy turned 4 this week, this time 4 years ago I was in the midst of Postpartum Psychosis believing I could never be a good mum. Now I know I am a good mum and today my boy wrapped his arms around me and said ‘you’re the best mummy in the world’ #heartmelted #pndchat #ppmums
So sweet, I remember my cat when I was in labour and in the bath came and laid on the bath mat calm as anything and after R was born, every time he cried, she’d go to him and howl as well 😍
He’s amazing, I literally could not have married a more perfect person! #blurtchats
I feel like my bond with my son was strengthened because of my PP, I loved him and cared for him more than I thought #MothersOnTheEdge #FromMe2MBU
Washing and drying R’s beloved Jessie Cat, no one prepares you for this part of parenthood! She actually looks white here, I think that’s a victory for me!
We adopted Twiglet and renamed her Blaize, so much better suited and had no issues x

I have my meds in a box am/pm, I aim to be heading to bed by 9:30, every Mon I do yoga including a yoga nidra, I’m spreading out my housework and having me time between, reading or puzzling or napping #o shout
Mines actually getting himself dressed for school without being nagged so he can have his!! Happy Days 😊

I am generally happier in the summer, my mental illness trigger points were (childbirth) in the autumn and (house move) in the winter so I’m more ‘at risk’ around those times, I think the light and weather do play their part though 🤷🏻‍♀️ #blurtchats
Feeling annoyed! My diary tells me that 2 years ago I was doing couch to 5k and had run for a total of 25mins, yesterday I struggled to run for 1 minute at a time 😩😩😩
